publication.body:
The podcast product now has a private source owner at https://github.com/agent-logic/the-cognitive-stack. This removes 182 migrated product files from ADL after a fresh GitHub clone verified all 521 imported files at 13f217d846b305f43943a50cbbdd6ee4292a1aef, including original provider contributions, drafts, licenses, and exact source hashes/modes.

The public feed, episode GUIDs and enclosure URLs are unchanged. Historical milestone/lifecycle evidence remains in ADL, with a relocation record; active consumers and validation routing now reference the migration contract. No deployment or provider spend occurred. Legacy runtime/machine-path dependencies are documented rather than claimed portable.

Validation: five focused migration/negative cases, 12 public validation-interface tests, registry generation check, offline launch/studio validators, and synthetic-tone audio-policy fixture passed. Bounded independent review approved the final implementation after two findings were fixed. The full #1223 retirement guard already fails at the unchanged baseline on retained-document identity drift; this PR records that limitation and preserves its guard through a narrowly pinned successor transition. Planning #12 owns the separate #1284 follow-up.

Closes #1285
